title: Thomas comes to New Orleans and joins a band in Algiers
summary: Thomas moves to New Orleans around 1923, has no teacher, studies briefly, and joins a band in Algiers after its trumpeter died.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When did you come to New Orleans, though?
I came to New Orleans in 20, the first war is 122, 23.
You came what, right after the war? After the war. About a year after the war.
I see. Did you have a teacher in the country?
When I came here, I went to Manu Mineta.

Yeah, hold it. Yeah. So you went to Mineta, huh? Yeah, I went to Mineta. And I went to Mineta, so after this boy, Elton Seto, he had the band, you know, trumpet player, drank some liquor in the cannon, got poison.

See, he dropped dead on the canal and ran port, you see. So, well, his brother-in-law told him, he said, well, I know a fella in my could get him to come down, you know what I mean? So, but I was already down here already, you see. I lived on Kyle Street, you see. So he said, you might get him. So sure enough, he written a letter to me, so he sent a letter to me. I got a letter, so he told me how to come over in the algae. I never been to algae before in my life. So I came right on over, just like he said, I came right on on Fred Street. I came right there, and his wife told me, he said, you sure find this place good. You know what I mean? For strange, you know what I mean? I came right on the couch, you know. So, well, there we, uh, he didn't have the trumpet player, well, I started playing with him, you know. And, uh, well, we wouldn't, uh, we wouldn't rehearse three and four times a week. Mm-hmm. We had a lot of jobs we could have, you know, a lot of weight, but we didn't want no jobs at all. We just wanted to rehearse and get the band together. See, so, after we got, after we got our band together, the first, the first dance I played in the algae is on Devil Street. Mm-hmm. At Devil, uh, uh, uh, uh, it was, uh, it was a, it was a corner. Uh, it was a, it was a corner. Uh, it was a, it was a corner. It wasn't a hall, it was a pavilion. And it rained all, it rained all day and all night. And from that on, we started playing. We used to go all over, play on the lake, play in the country, play in the country, Raceland, Lockport, Gold Medal, down the, the Grand Isles, all over. Timberto, Homer, all over. Baton Rouge, everywhere, man, Texas, all over, see?
